## Information
Brighten up your home this Christmas with these enchanting LED Fairy lights Christmas decorations. These lights are the perfect addition to any festive display. However, they are not just for Christmas, this set can be used at any point of the year and in a variety of ways, ideal for providing ambient lighting and creating eye-catching scenes. Featuring bright non-replaceable LEDs, these are perfect for anywhere around your home or garden whether you choose to wrap them around a mantelpiece, banister or Christmas Tree. Fitted with a selector button, there are 8 settings. These include static, in waves, sequential, slo glo, chasing flash, slow fade, twinkle flash and off. Suitable for indoor and outdoor use (battery pack features a water-tight seal).
